brief:
Israeli forces demolished approximately 50 structures, including homes and livestock shelters, in the Palestinian community of Samra in Tubas, the Middle East Eye reported. The operation occurred without prior notice to residents of the livestock farming settlement.

The demolition destroyed dwellings and farm infrastructure used by community members who depend on animal husbandry for their livelihoods. Samra is located in the occupied West Bank.
